title: Emil Kowalski — enforce rules so agents use your design system
note: To get an agent to use your design system properly, you need to enforce rules: lint rules and strict type-safe props, CI checks that fail on component misuse, docs on when and how to use each component, and semantic tokens. She saved it for skills inspo. The angle: the enforcement layer for her skills post — her skills tell an agent what to do, Emil's rules are how you make it actually do it.
